messages:
mira: spinning up a quick onboarding for a new compact model 'ripple-emb' (dim=640). initial sanity eval on our semsim holdout looks odd, posting numbers.
sam: paste the run cmd and the artifact links pls.
mira: run:
```
./bin/eval_embeddings --model ripple-emb --quant int6_pc --holdout semsim-5k --norm l2 --batch 512 --seed 7
```
artifacts: s3://rwd-evals/ripple/4478901234/{recall.json,shift_report.csv,calib_stats.json}
summary:
```
Baseline (roberta-768): recall@1=0.70 recall@10=0.94 avg_top1_shift=0.02 silhouette=0.26
Ripple int6_pc: recall@1=0.61 recall@10=0.90 avg_top1_shift=0.18 silhouette=0.14
```
liam: avg_top1_shift 0.18 is high. did you run a calibration vector-pass? small cal can fix zero-point bias.
mira: default calib was used (N=2k). I also checked embedding norms and they look ok.
sam: two quick probes: 1) run same checkpoint fp16 to isolate quant error; 2) compute PCA projection of baseline->640 to estimate dim loss effect.
bench-bot: queued fp16 run (job 4478901240), queued baseline->pca probe (job 4478901241).
(10m)
bench-bot: job 4478901240 complete: ripple fp16 recall@1=0.69 recall@10=0.93 silhouette=0.25. artifacts -> s3://rwd-evals/ripple/4478901240/
sam: fp16 close to baseline, so quant is main suspect. try symmetric quant and int8 per-channel as comparisons. also run a larger calib (10k) and a per-dim scale capture.
mira: queued int6_sym, int8_pc, int6_pc+calib10k, and will collect per-dim error stats.
(8m)
mira: quick results:
```
int6_pc (orig): recall@1=0.61 recall@10=0.90 avg_top1_shift=0.18
int6_sym: recall@1=0.66 recall@10=0.92 avg_top1_shift=0.11
int8_pc: recall@1=0.69 recall@10=0.93 avg_top1_shift=0.04
int6_pc calib10k: recall@1=0.64 recall@10=0.91 avg_top1_shift=0.10
```
liam: pattern matches quant noise dominating. int6_sym better than int6_pc here, int8 close to fp16. per-dim error heatmap shows a handful of dims with heavy clipping in int6_pc causing rank flips.
sam: action plan: default to int8_pc for now; keep int6 as an opt-in with an expanded calibration + per-dim clipping mitigation. we should add a diagnostic metric to CI: fraction_of_queries_with_top1_flip>0.05 triggers warning.
mira: agree. Ill open a tiny patch that plugs per-dim scale capture into the quant pipeline and emits that metric. planning a canary: run int6_sym on 2% of staging traffic with shadow comparisons for 48h.
liam: also raise a follow-up to test alternative projection heads (layernorm before projector) since those can reduce quant sensitivity.
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-1289 "ripple quant calibration + rollout plan" (link)
sam: please attach the neighbor-shift matrix and the per-dim clipping plots in the ticket. mira can you also estimate cost delta int8 vs int6* (GPU memory/throughput)?
mira: quick back-of-envelope: int6 peak throughput +25% vs int8, but int6 needs extra calibration overhead and more evals. will compute detailed numbers and add to the ticket.
sam: good. for the rollout checklist: 1) 5 holdout evals pass (recall@1 drop <0.02, silhouette drop <0.03), 2) neighbor-flip fraction <0.05, 3) ops canary approval, 4) benchmarked latency/cost within target.
liam: I'll take ops canary review.
mira: thanks all, pushing the PR for calibration hook and the diagnostic exporter now. bench artifacts and scripts at s3 link in ticket.
bench-bot: PR 8190 opened by mira: "ripple: quant calib hook + neighbor-shift diagnostic"
ops-bot: canary window scheduled: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC
mira: will follow up with final numbers after the canary. cheers! :rocket:
